title: Arsenal sandbox test result
description: Contract the sandbox agent must satisfy. The host validates this file and owns the Pass/Fail verdict.

commit.description: Git revision under test, or "unknown" when the project is not a git repository.

finished_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp with timezone, later than started_at.

total.description: Total number of tests. Zero counts as a failure: an empty suite proves nothing.

blocked.description: Anything that prevented part of the suite from running. Non-empty means the run fails.
